title: Grateful Dead Live at Glens Falls Civic Center on 1982-04-14

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard recording captures a high‑energy 1982 show with a smoking China‑Rider, monster Jack Straw and solid Playin’ in the Band.
ai_review.review: The tape is a clean soundboard source that most listeners describe as crisp and well balanced, though a few note vocal mix quirks. Musically the concert shines in the second set – especially the China‑Rider jam and an inspired Playin’ in the Band – while the first set is seen by some as uneven. Overall the performance is regarded as one of the stronger 1982 outings despite isolated complaints about sloppy moments.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 4‑5 stars praising both the music and sound, with only a handful of low scores. Weighted scoring (70 % show, 30 % recording) yields an overall rating around 4.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Most reviewers call the mix crisp and articulate; a few mention vocals pushed too high in the mix and occasional hiss, but no major drop‑outs.

poor_songs: First set overall (noted as sloppy by some listeners)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The first set is described as uneven and occasionally sluggish, but the second set builds momentum with tight transitions into a long China‑Rider jam and a powerful Playin' in the Band.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's voice is praised as still good; his guitar is loud and often highlighted, though some note occasional hung‑up solo spots and moments of sloppiness.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir gets credit for strong front‑line presence and notable slide work in Playin' in the Band; several reviewers call out his “chromatic wash” on Bertha.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s keyboards are mentioned both positively (understated, busy, adds sparkle) and negatively (vocals too high, occasional mix dominance).
